G4771.root: the personal pronoun of the second person singular
senses: pron. of 2nd of person(s), thou, you, genitive, σοῦ, dative, σοί, accusative, σέ, pl., ὑμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς (enclitic in oblique cases sing., except after prep. (BL, §48, 3), though πρὸς σέ occurs in [[r:MAT.25.39|Mat 25:39]]). Nom. for emphasis or contrast: [[r:JHN.1.30|Jhn 1:30, 4:10, 5:33, 39, 44]], [[r:ACT.4.7|Act 4:7]], [[r:EPH.5.32|Eph 5:32]]; so also perhaps σὺ εἶπας, [[r:MAT.26.64|Mat 26:64]], al. (M, Pr., 86); before voc., [[r:MAT.2.6|Mat 2:6]], [[r:LUK.1.76|Luk 1:76]], [[r:JHN.17.5|Jhn 17:5]], al.; sometimes without emphasis (M, Pr., 85f.), as also in cl., but esp. as rendering of Heb. phrase, e.g. υἱός μου εἶ σύ (בְּנִי־אַתָּה, [[r:PSA.2.7|Psa 2:7]]), [[r:ACT.13.33|Act 13:33]]. The genitive (σοῦ, ὑμῶν) is sometimes placed bef. the noun: [[r:LUK.7.48|Luk 7:48, 12:30]], al.; so also the enclitic σοῦ, [[r:MAT.9.6|Mat 9:6]]; on τί ἐμοὶ κ. σοί, see: ἐγώ. (AS)

G4750.root: probably strengthened from a presumed derivative of the base of [[w:G5114]]
G4750.strongs: the mouth (as if a gash in the face); by implication, language (and its relations); figuratively, an opening (in the earth); specially, the front or edge (of a weapon)
senses: the mouth: of man, [[r:MAT.15.11|Mat 15:11]], [[r:JHN.19.29|Jhn 19:29]], [[r:ACT.11.8|Act 11:8]], al.; of animals, [[r:MAT.17.27|Mat 17:27]], [[r:2TI.4.17|2Ti 4:17]] (fig.), [[r:HEB.11.33|Heb 11:33]], [[r:JAS.3.3|Jas 3:3]], al.; figuratively, of inanimate things (ποταμοῦ, Hom.), ἤνοιξεν ἡ γῆ τὸ σ., [[r:REV.12.16|Rev 12:16]]; σ. μαχαίρας (Heb. חֶרֶב ־פֶּה, [[r:GEN.34.26|Gen 34:26]] al.), the edge of the sword, [[r:LUK.21.24|Luk 21:24]], [[r:HEB.11.34|Heb 11:34]]; esp. of the mouth as the organ of speech: opposite to καρδία, [[r:MAT.12.34|Mat 12:34]], [[r:ROM.10.8|Rom 10:8, 10]]; in various phrases (some cl., some resembling Hebrew; cf. Bl., § 40, 9): ἀνοίγειν τ. σ. (see: ἀνοίγω); σ. πρὸς σ. (פֶּה ־אֵל פֶּה [[r:NUM.12.8|Num 12:8]]; = cl., κατὰ σ., Hdt., al.), face to face, II Jn 12, 3Jn 14; διὰ τοῦ σ. (of the Holy Spirit), [[r:LUK.1.70|Luk 1:70]], [[r:ACT.1.16|Act 1:16]], al.; ἀπὸ (ἐκ) τοῦ σ. (cf. ἀπὸ σ. εἰπεῖν, Plat., al.), of speaking by word of mouth, [[r:LUK.22.71|Luk 22:71]], [[r:ACT.22.14|Act 22:14]]; δόλος (ψεῦδος) ἐν τ. σ., [[r:1PE.2.22|1Pe 2:22]], [[r:REV.14.5|Rev 14:5]]" (LXX); metaphorically, ἡ ῥομφαία τοῦ σ., [[r:REV.2.16|Rev 2:16.]] By meton., for speech (Soph.): [[r:MAT.18.16|Mat 18:16]] (LXX), [[r:LUK.19.22|Luk 19:22 21:15]], [[r:2CO.13.1|2Co 13:1]] (AS)

G4762.strongs: to twist, i.e. turn quite around or reverse (literally or figuratively)
G4762.kjv: convert, turn (again, back again, self, self about)
senses: στρέφω to turn: with accusative of thing(s) dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.5.39|Mat 5:39]]; = ἀποσ-, to bring back, [[r:MAT.27.3|Mat 27:3]] (cf. [[r:ISA.38.8|Isa 38:8]]); reflexively (WM, § 38, 1), to turn oneself, [[r:ACT.7.42|Act 7:42]]; with accusative before εἰς, = μετασ-, to change, [[r:REV.11.6|Rev 11:6.]] Pass., reflexive, to turn oneself: before εἰς, [[r:JHN.20.14|Jhn 20:14]], [[r:ACT.7.39|Act 7:39 13:46]]; ptcp., στραφείς, with indic., [[r:MAT.7.6|Mat 7:6 9:22 16:23]], [[r:LUK.7.9|Luk 7:9 9:55 14:25 22:61]], [[r:JHN.1.38|Jhn 1:38 20:16]]; id. before πρός, [[r:LUK.7.44|Luk 7:44 10:22]] (WH, R, om.), [[r:LUK.7.23|Luk 7:23 23:28]]; metaphorically, to change: absol., [[r:MAT.18.3|Mat 18:3]], [[r:JHN.12.40|Jhn 12:40]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ, ἐπι-, κατα-, μετα-, συ(ν)-, ὑπο-στρέφω).† (AS)
narrow: fig (v MM, xxiii), [[r:MAT.7.13|Mat 7:13-14]], [[r:LUK.13.24|Luk 13:24]].† (AS)

G4718.strongs: a cluster of grapes (as if intertwined)
senses: a bunch of grapes: [[r:MAT.7.16|Mat 7:16]], [[r:LUK.6.44|Luk 6:44]], [[r:REV.14.18|Rev 14:18]]. "σ. is properly the ripe grape-cluster as opposite to ὄμφαξ, cf. [[r:GEN.40.10|Gen 40:10]], [[r:JOB.15.33|Job 15:33]]; as contrasted with βότρυς, it describes the grapes rather than the cluster on which they grow" (Swete, Apoc., 187 f.).† (AS)

G4721.root: strengthened from a primary τέγος (a "thatch" or "deck" of a building)
senses: (στέγω) a roof: [[r:MRK.2.4|Mrk 2:4]]; of entering a house, εἰσέρχεσθαι ὑπὸ τὴν σ., [[r:MAT.8.8|Mat 8:8]], [[r:LUK.7.6|Luk 7:6]] (cf. MM, xxiii).† (AS)

G4757.root: from a presumed derivative of the same as [[w:G4756]]
G4757.strongs: a camper-out, i.e. a (common) warrior (literally or figuratively)
senses: a soldier: [[r:MAT.8.9|Mat 8:9]], [[r:MRK.15.16|Mrk 15:16]], [[r:JHN.19.2|Jhn 19:2]], [[r:ACT.10.7|Act 10:7]], al.; metaphorically, σ. Χριστοῦ Ἰησ., [[r:2TI.2.3|2Ti 2:3.]]† (AS)
dimin. of στρουθός a sparrow: [[r:MAT.10.29|Mat 10:29, 31]], [[r:LUK.12.6|Luk 12:6-7]].† (AS)

G4716.strongs: a stake or post (as set upright), i.e. (specially), a pole or cross (as an instrument of capital punishment); figuratively, exposure to death, i.e. self-denial; by implication, the atonement of Christ
senses: an upright pale or stake (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.)

In late writers (Diod., Plut., al.) of the Roman instrument of crucifixion, the Cross: of the Cross on which Christ suffered, [[r:MAT.27.32|Mat 27:32, 40 27:42]], [[r:MRK.15.21|Mrk 15:21, 30 15:32]], [[r:LUK.23.26|Luk 23:26]], [[r:JHN.19.17|Jhn 19:17, 19 19:25, 31]], [[r:COL.2.14|Col 2:14]], [[r:HEB.12.2|Heb 12:2]]; θάνατος σταυροῦ, [[r:PHP.2.8|Php 2:8]]; τ. αἷμα τοῦ σ., [[r:COL.1.20|Col 1:20.]] Metaphorical, in proverbial sayings: αἴρειν (λαμβάνειν, βαστάζειν) τὸν σ., [[r:MAT.10.38|Mat 10:38 16:24]], [[r:MRK.8.34|Mrk 8:34 10:21]], 15:21, [[r:LUK.9.23|Luk 9:23 14:27]] (for an interesting ex. of metaphorically use in π., see MM, xxiii) By meton., for Christ's death on the Cross: [[r:1CO.1.17|1Co 1:17]], [[r:GAL.5.11|Gal 5:11 6:12, 14]], [[r:EPH.2.16|Eph 2:16]], [[r:PHP.3.18|Php 3:18]]; ὁ λόγος ὁ τοῦ σ., [[r:1CO.1.18|1Co 1:18.]]† (AS)

G4702.strongs: sown, i.e. (neuter plural) a planted field
senses: (σπείρω) fit for sowing, sown; as subst., τὰ σ., corn-fields: [[r:MAT.12.1|Mat 12:1]], [[r:MRK.2.23|Mrk 2:23]], [[r:LUK.6.1|Luk 6:1]].† (AS)

G4719.strongs: a head of grain (as standing out from the stalk)

G4712.strongs: a stade or certain measure of distance; by implication, a stadium or race-course
senses: στάδιον, -ου, τό pl., στάδια ([[r:JHN.6.19|Jhn 6:19]], T), and metapl., στάδιοι (see B1., 9, 1), a stadium, i.e.

a measure of length = 600 Greek feet or 1⁄8 of a Roman mile [[r:MAT.14.24|Mat 14:24]] (Rec., WH, txt., R, mg.), [[r:LUK.24.13|Luk 24:13]], [[r:JHN.6.19|Jhn 6:19 11:18]], [[r:REV.14.20|Rev 14:20 21:16]], and, this being the length of the Olympic course,
a race-course: [[r:1CO.9.24|1Co 9:24.]]† (AS)

σφυρίς (T, Rec. σπυρίς, see WH, App., 148; 131., § 6, 7), -ίδος, ἡ, a flexible mat-basket for carrying provisions: [[r:MAT.15.37|Mat 15:37 16:10]], [[r:MRK.8.8|Mrk 8:8, 20]] [[r:ACT.9.25|Act 9:25]] (see: κόφινος).† (AS)

G4768.strongs: to render gloomy, i.e. (by implication) glower (be overcast with clouds, or sombreness of speech)
senses: (στυγνός, sombre, gloomy, sullen, [[r:ISA.5.17|Isa 5:17]], [[r:WIS.17.5|Wis 17:5]], Dan LXX 2:12*), to have a sombre, gloomy appearance: of the human countenance (RV, his countenance fell), [[r:MRK.10.22|Mrk 10:22]]; of the sky (so στυγνότης, Polyb., iv, 21, 1), [[r:MAT.16.3|Mat 16:3]] (, R, mg., om.).† (AS)

G4715.strongs: a stander (standard of value), i.e. (specially), a stater or certain coin
senses: a stater;
a weight;
a coin (used by late writers of the Greek τετράδραχμον): [[r:MAT.17.27|Mat 17:27 26:16]], WH, mg.† (AS)

G4717.strongs: to impale on the cross; figuratively, to extinguish (subdue) passion or selfishness
senses: (σταυρός),
to fence with pales, impalisade (Thuc.).

In late writers (Polyb., FlJ; but ἀνασταυρόω is more common) to crucify: with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.20.19|Mat 20:19 23:34 26:2 27:22]] ff. [[r:MAT.28.5|Mat 28:5]], [[r:MRK.15.16|Mrk 15:16]] ff. [[r:MRK.16.6|Mrk 16:6]], [[r:LUK.23.21|Luk 23:21, 23 23:33 24:7, 20]], [[r:JHN.19.6|Jhn 19:6]] ff., [[r:ACT.2.36|Act 2:36 4:10]], [[r:1CO.1.13|1Co 1:13 1:23 2:2 2:8]], [[r:2CO.13.4|2Co 13:4]], [[r:GAL.3.1|Gal 3:1]], [[r:REV.11.8|Rev 11:8]]; metaphorically, [[r:GAL.5.24|Gal 5:24 6:14]].† (AS)

G4766.root: prolongation from a still simpler στρόω, (used only as an alternate in certain tenses) (probably akin to [[w:G4731]] through the idea of positing)
G4766.strongs: to "strew," i.e. spread (as a carpet or couch)
senses: στρωννύω or στρώννυμι (seeBl., § 23, 1; Veitch, see word), to spread: ἱμάτια ἐν τ. ὁδῷ (εἰς τ. ὁδόν), [[r:MAT.21.8|Mat 21:8]], [[r:MRK.11.8|Mrk 11:8]]; of making a bed, στρῶσον (sc. τ. κλίνην) σεαυτῷ, [[r:ACT.9.34|Act 9:34]]; of furnishing a room, ἐστρωμένον, spread with carpets or carpeted couches (cf. [[r:EZK.23.41|Eze 23:41]]), [[r:MRK.14.15|Mrk 14:15]], [[r:LUK.22.12|Luk 22:12]].† (AS)

G4753.strongs: an armament, i.e. (by implication) a body of troops (more or less extensive or systematic)
senses: (στρατεύω),
= στρατεία (Hdt., al.).
an army, a host: pl., [[r:MAT.22.7|Mat 22:7]], [[r:REV.9.16|Rev 9:16 19:14, 19]]; = soldiers, company of soldiers, [[r:ACT.23.10|Act 23:10, 27]]; pl., [[r:LUK.23.11|Luk 23:11.]]† (AS)

G4735.root: from an apparently primary στέφω (to twine or wreathe)
G4735.strongs: a chaplet (as a badge of royalty, a prize in the public games or a symbol of honor generally; but more conspicuous and elaborate than the simple fillet,), literally or figuratively
senses: (στέφω, to encircle),
that which surrounds or encompasses (as a wall, a crowd: Hom., al.).

a crown, i.e. the wreath, garland or chaplet given as a prize for victory, as a festal ornament, or as a public honour for disting­uished service or personal worth (so to sovereigns, especially on the occasion of a παρουσία, which see; cf. Deiss., LAE, 372 ff.; on its use in LXX for the golden crown of royalty (prop., διάδημα, which see, cf. Hort and Mayor on [[r:JAS.1.12|Jas 1:12]]): [[r:MAT.27.29|Mat 27:29]], [[r:MRK.15.17|Mrk 15:17]], [[r:JHN.19.2|Jhn 19:2]], 5, [[r:1CO.9.25|1Co 9:25]], [[r:REV.4.4|Rev 4:4, 10 6:2 9:7 12:1 14:14]]. Metaphorical: [[r:PHP.4.1|Php 4:1]], [[r:REV.3.11|Rev 3:11]]; τ. δικαιοσύνης (cf. Deiss., LAE, 312), [[r:2TI.4.8|2Ti 4:8]]; τ. δόξης, [[r:1PE.5.4|1Pe 5:4]]; καυχήσεως, [[r:1TH.2.19|1Th 2:19]] (see M, Th., in l); τ. ζωῆς (genitive appos.), [[r:JAS.1.12|Jas 1:12]], [[r:REV.2.10|Rev 2:10]].† (AS)

G4739.strongs: to be stationary, i.e. (figuratively) to persevere
senses: στήκω late Pres., formed from perf., ἕστηκα (see B1., § 17; WH, App., 169; Kennedy, Sources, 158; M, Pr., 238; MM, xxiii), = ἵστημι, to stand: [[r:MRK.3.31|Mrk 3:31 11:25]], [[r:JHN.1.26|Jhn 1:26]], [[r:REV.12.4|Rev 12:4]] (ἕστηκεν T). Metaphorical, to stand firm, stand fast: absol., [[r:GAL.5.1|Gal 5:1]] (but see Field, Notes, 189 f.), [[r:2TH.2.15|2Th 2:15]]; before ἐν, [[r:JHN.8.44|Jhn 8:44]] (ἕστηκεν, T, R, mg.), [[r:1CO.16.13|1Co 16:13]], [[r:PHP.1.27|Php 1:27 4:1]]; with dative, [[r:ROM.14.4|Rom 14:4.]]† (AS)

G4703.strongs: a scattering (of seed), i.e. (concretely) seed (as sown)
senses: (σπείρω), = σπορά,
sowing or seedtime.
seed sown (so usually in late Gk.): [[r:MRK.4.26|Mrk 4:26-27]], [[r:LUK.8.5|Luk 8:5, 11]], [[r:2CO.9.10|2Co 9:10]] a (LTr.); metaphorically, of almsgiving, [[r:2CO.9.10|2Co 9:10]] b.† (AS)

G4773.strongs: a relative (by blood); by extension, a fellow countryman
senses: σνγγενής, -ές (dative pl., -εῦσιν, [[r:MRK.6.4|Mrk 6:4]], [[r:LUK.2.44|Luk 2:44]], as though from -εύς, see Swete, Mk., l.with; Bl., § 8, 6; cf. [[r:1MA.10.89|1Ma 10:89]] A א2 *;) (σύν, γένος),
congenital, natural, innate.

akin to; as subst., a kinsman: [[r:MRK.6.4|Mrk 6:4]], [[r:LUK.1.58|Luk 1:58 2:44 14:12 21:16]], [[r:JHN.18.26|Jhn 18:26]], [[r:ACT.10.24|Act 10:24]]; of tribal kinship, [[r:ROM.9.3|Rom 9:3 16:7, 11 16:21]].† SYN.: ἴδιος, οἰκεῖος (which see) (AS)
(σπεύδω),

zeal, diligence, earnestness: [[r:ROM.12.11|Rom 12:11]], [[r:2CO.7.11|2Co 7:11-12 8:7-8]]; ἐν σ., [[r:ROM.12.8|Rom 12:8]] (see M, Pr, 104); before ὑπέρ, [[r:2CO.8.16|2Co 8:16]]; σπουδὴν ἐνδείκνυσθαι, [[r:HEB.6.11|Heb 6:11]]; σ. παρεισφέρειν, [[r:2PE.1.5|2Pe 1:5]]; πᾶσαν σ. ποιεῖσθαι, Ju 3 (see MM, xxiii; M, Pr., 214; Deiss., BS, 361, 364).† (AS)

G4727.strongs: to make (intransitively, be) in straits, i.e. (by implication) to sigh, murmur, pray inaudibly
senses: στενάζω to groan ("the word denotes feeling which is internal and unexpressed," Mayor, Ja., 162): [[r:MRK.7.34|Mrk 7:34]], [[r:2CO.5.2|2Co 5:2 5:4]], [[r:HEB.13.17|Heb 13:17]], [[r:JAS.5.9|Jas 5:9]] (EV, murmur); ἐν ἑαυτοῖς, [[r:ROM.8.23|Rom 8:23]] (cf. ἀνα-, συ(ν)-στενάζω).† SYN.: see: κλαίω (AS)
στίλβω to shine, glisten: [[r:MRK.9.3|Mrk 9:3.]]† (AS)

G4746.strongs: a spread (as if tramped flat) of loose materials for a couch, i.e. (by implication) a bough of a tree so employed
senses: στοιβάς, see: στιβάς. στιβάς, -άδος, ἡ, a litter of leaves or rushes: pl., [[r:MRK.11.8|Mrk 11:8]] (Rec. στοιβ-).† (AS)

G4749.strongs: equipment, i.e. (specially), a "stole" or long-fitting gown (as a mark of dignity)
senses: (στέλλω),
1, an equipment, an armament (Æsch.).

Equipment in clothes, apparel, esp. flowing raiment, a festal robe: (cf. [[r:JON.3.6|Jon 3:6]], [[r:EST.8.15|Est 8:15]], [[r:1MA.6.15|1Ma 6:15]]): [[r:MRK.12.38|Mrk 12:38 16:5]], [[r:LUK.15.22|Luk 15:22 20:46]], [[r:REV.6.11|Rev 6:11 7:9, 13-14 22:14]].† (AS)

G4775.strongs: to seat oneself in company with
senses: συν-κάθημαι (Rec. συγκ-), to sit together or with: with dative, [[r:ACT.26.30|Act 26:30]]; before μετά, with genitive, [[r:MRK.14.54|Mrk 14:54.]]† (AS)

G4714.strongs: a standing (properly, the act), i.e. (by analogy) position (existence); by implication, a popular uprising; figuratively, controversy
senses: (ἵστημι),
a standing, place, status: σ. ἔχειν (Polyb., v, 5, 3; and cf. Lat. locum habere), [[r:HEB.9.8|Heb 9:8.]]
In poets and late prose, strife, dissension (cf. MM, xxiii) [[r:ACT.15.2|Act 15:2 23:7, 10]].† (AS)

συν-καλέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, to call together: with accusative, [[r:MRK.15.16|Mrk 15:16]], [[r:LUK.15.6|Luk 15:6]], 9 (seel. -εῖται, see B1., § 55, 1), [[r:ACT.5.21|Act 5:21.]] Mid., to call together to oneself: [[r:LUK.9.1|Luk 9:1]] (and seel. in [[r:LUK.15.6|Luk 15:6]], 9 see supr.) [[r:LUK.23.13|Luk 23:13]], [[r:ACT.10.24|Act 10:24 28:17]].† (AS)

G4723.root: a contraction from [[w:G4731]] (as stiff and unnatural)
senses: στεῖρος, -ον also -α, -ον, barren: of a woman, [[r:LUK.1.7|Luk 1:7, 36 23:29]], [[r:GAL.4.27|Gal 4:27]]" (LXX).† (AS)
συν-χαίρω (Rec. συγ-),
to rejoice with: with dative of person(s), [[r:LUK.1.58|Luk 1:58 15:6, 9]], [[r:PHP.2.17|Php 2:17-18]], EV; with dative of thing(s), [[r:1CO.12.26|1Co 12:26 13:6]].
to congratulate (Æschin., Polyb., al.): Phi, l.with (Lft., in I.; cf. MM, xxiv).† (AS)
(συγγενής),
kinship.
By meton., kinsfolk, kindred: [[r:LUK.1.61|Luk 1:61]], [[r:ACT.7.3|Act 7:3, 14]] † (AS)

G4756.root: feminine of a derivative of στρατός (an army
G4756.strongs: from the base of, as encamped); camp-likeness, i.e. an army, i.e. (figuratively) the angels, the celestial luminaries
senses: = στρατός, an army, a host: of angels ([[r:3KI.22.19|3Ki 22:19]], al.), [[r:LUK.2.13|Luk 2:13]]; of the stars of heaven ([[r:JER.8.2|Jer 8:2]], [[r:2CH.33.3|2Ch 33:3]]), [[r:ACT.7.42|Act 7:42]].
As sometimes in cl. (poët.), = στρατεία: [[r:2CO.10.4|2Co 10:4]], T (WH, RV, στρατεία).† (AS)

G4754.root: middle voice from the base of [[w:G4756]]
G4754.strongs: to serve in a military campaign; figuratively, to execute the apostolate (with its arduous duties and functions), to contend with carnal inclinations
senses: στρατεύω and depon., -ομαι, so always in NT (στρατός, an encamped army), used of the general, to make war, do battle, and (chiefly) of the soldiers serving under him, to serve as a soldier: [[r:LUK.3.14|Luk 3:14]], [[r:1CO.9.7|1Co 9:7]], [[r:2TI.2.4|2Ti 2:4]]. Metaphorical (cf. MM, ii, xxiii), of spiritual conflict, to war, make war: [[r:2CO.10.3|2Co 10:3]], [[r:1TI.1.18|1Ti 1:18]], [[r:JAS.4.1|Jas 4:1]], [[r:1PE.2.11|1Pe 2:11]].† (AS)

G4743.strongs: a point of time, i.e. an instant
senses: (στίζω, to prick), a prick, a point; metaphorically, σ. χρόνου, a moment: [[r:LUK.4.5|Luk 4:5.]]† (AS)

G4788.strongs: to shut together, i.e. include or (figuratively) embrace in a common subjection to
senses: συν-κλείω (Rec. συγκ-), to shut together, enclose, shut in on all sides: of a catch of fish, [[r:LUK.5.6|Luk 5:6]]; metaphorically ([[r:PSA.31.9|Psa 31:9]], al.), [[r:ROM.11.32|Rom 11:32]], [[r:GAL.3.22|Gal 3:22-23]].† (AS)
adv. (σπουδαῖος),

with haste or zeal, i.e. earnestly, zealously, diligently: [[r:LUK.7.4|Luk 7:4]], [[r:2TI.1.17|2Ti 1:17]], [[r:TIT.3.13|Tit 3:13]]; compar., -οτέρως, [[r:PHP.2.28|Php 2:28]] (RV, Lft., Weymouth, al., but see infr.)
hastily, speedily: compar., -οτέρως, [[r:PHP.2.28|Php 2:28]] (Thayer, Zorell, see word; ICC, in l, al., but see supr.).† (AS)

G4741.strongs: to set fast, i.e. (literally) to turn resolutely in a certain direction, or (figuratively) to confirm
senses: στηρίζω to fix, set fast, make fast: [[r:LUK.16.26|Luk 16:26]]; τ. πρόσωτον ([[r:EZK.6.2|Eze 6:2 13:17]], al.; see Dalman, Words, 30 f.), [[r:LUK.9.51|Luk 9:51.]] Metaphorical, to confirm, establish: with, accusative, [[r:LUK.22.32|Luk 22:32]], [[r:ACT.18.23|Act 18:23]], [[r:ROM.1.11|Rom 1:11 16:25]], [[r:1TH.3.2|1Th 3:2 3:13]], [[r:2TH.3.3|2Th 3:3]], [[r:JAS.5.8|Jas 5:8]], [[r:1PE.5.10|1Pe 5:10]], [[r:REV.3.2|Rev 3:2]]; id. before ἐν, [[r:2TH.2.17|2Th 2:17]], [[r:2PE.1.12|2Pe 1:12]].† (AS)

G4795.root: from a comparative of [[w:G4862]] and κυρέω (to light or happen
G4795.strongs: from the base of); concurrence, i.e. accident
senses: (συγκυρέω, to happen), (more frequently in late writers, συγκύρησις, -ημα), chance, coincidence: κατὰ σ. (see MM, xxiii), [[r:LUK.10.31|Luk 10:31]] (Hippocr., Eccl.).† (AS)
συν-καλύπτω (Rec. συγκ-), to veil or cover completely: with accusative, pass., [[r:LUK.12.2|Luk 12:2.]]† (AS)

G4794.strongs: to stoop altogether, i.e. be completely overcome by
senses: συν-κύπτω (Rec. συγκ-),
to bend forwards (Arist., al.).
to be bowed down: [[r:LUK.13.11|Luk 13:11.]]† (AS)
the breast: [[r:JHN.13.25|Jhn 13:25 21:10]], [[r:REV.15.6|Rev 15:6]]; as a sign of penitence, τύπτειν (εἰς) τὸ σ., [[r:LUK.18.13|Luk 18:13 23:48]],† (AS)

G4760.root: from the base of [[w:G4756]] and the same as [[w:G3977]]
G4760.strongs: a camping-ground, i.e. (by implication) a body of troops
senses: στρατό-πεδον, -ου, τό (στρατός + πέδον, a plain),
a military camp;

G4755.root: from the base of [[w:G4756]] and [[w:G0071]] or [[w:G2233]]
G4755.strongs: a general, i.e. (by implication or analogy) a (military) governor (prætor), the chief (præfect) of the (Levitical) temple-wardens
senses: (στραός, ἄγω),
a military commander, a general (Hdt., al.).
A civic commander, a governor, magistrate (Hdt., Xen., al.): [[r:ACT.16.20|Act 16:20, 22 16:35-36, 38]].

The commander of the Levitical guard of the Temple, ὁ σ. τ. ἱεροῦ (EV, captain of the Temple): [[r:ACT.4.1|Act 4:1 5:24, 26]]; pl., [[r:LUK.22.4|Luk 22:4, 52]].† SYN.: ἄρχων (cf. EGT on [[r:ACT.16.20|Act 16:20]]; Ramsay, St. Paul, 217). (AS)

G4776.strongs: to give (or take) a seat in company with
senses: περι-καθ-ίζω
to invest, besiege (Diod., 4Ki.6:24, [[r:1MA.11.61|1Ma 11:61]], al.).
to sit around: [[r:LUK.22.55|Luk 22:55]], L, txt. † (AS)

G4784.strongs: to deposit (one's vote or opinion) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to accord with
senses: συν-κατα-τίθημι (Rec. συγκ-), to deposit together. Mid., to deposit one's vote with, hence, to agree with, assent to: with dative, [[r:LUK.23.51|Luk 23:51.]]† (AS)

G4798.strongs: to use jointly, i.e. (by implication) to hold intercourse in common
senses: συν-χράομαι (Rec. συγ-), -ῶμαι, to use together with. Metaphorical, with dative of person(s), to associate with: [[r:JHN.4.9|Jhn 4:9]] (Polyb., a1.).† (AS)
a portico: [[r:JHN.5.2|Jhn 5:2]]; used of the covered colonnade in the Temple (EV, porch), [[r:JHN.10.23|Jhn 10:23]] [[r:ACT.3.11|Act 3:11 5:12]] † (AS)

G4785.root: from [[w:G4862]] and a compound of [[w:G2596]] and [[w:G5585]]
G4785.strongs: to count down in company with, i.e. enroll among
senses: συν-κατα-ψηφίζω (Rec. συγκ-),
to condemn with or together (Plut., Themist., 21).
to vote one a place among: pass., [[r:ACT.1.26|Act 1:26.]] Not elsewhere.† (AS)

G4797.root: from [[w:G4862]] and χέω (to pour) or its alternate
G4797.strongs: to commingle promiscuously, i.e. (figuratively) to throw (an assembly) into disorder, to perplex (the mind)
G4797.kjv: confound, confuse, stir up, be in an uproar
senses: συν-χέω (Rec. συγ-), to pour together, commingle, confuse; metaphorically, confound, throw into confusion, stir up trouble: [[r:ACT.21.27|Act 21:27]] (cf. συν-χύννω).† (AS)

G4732.strongs: to solidify, i.e. confirm (literally or figuratively)
senses: (στερεός),
to make firm or solid;

to strengthen, make strong; with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.3.16|Act 3:16]]; τ. βάσεις, pass., [[r:ACT.3.7|Act 3:7.]] Metaphorical (cf. Je, l.with): τ. πίστει, pass., [[r:ACT.16.5|Act 16:5.]]† (AS)

G4787.strongs: to move together, i.e. (specially), to excite as a mass (to sedition)
senses: συν-κινέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, to move together. Metaphorical, to excite, stir up: τ. λαόν, [[r:ACT.6.12|Act 6:12]] (Arist., Polyb., al.).† (AS)
(στενάζω), a groaning: [[r:ACT.7.34|Act 7:34]] (LXX κραυγή), [[r:ROM.8.26|Rom 8:26.]]† (AS)

G4792.strongs: to convey together, i.e. collect or bear away in company with others
senses: συν-κομίζω (Rec. συγκ-),
to bring together, collect (Hdt., Xen., al.).
to take up a body for burial (Soph., Aj., 1048): [[r:ACT.8.2|Act 8:2]] (see Field, Notes, 116).† (AS)
(στέφω, to put around, enwreath) a wreath, garland: as used in sacrifices, [[r:ACT.14.13|Act 14:13.]]† (AS)

G4770.strongs: a "Stoic" (as occupying a particular porch in Athens), i.e. adherent of a certin philosophy
senses: Στωικός (Rec. -ϊκός, T, Στοϊκός), -ή, -όν, Stoic: [[r:ACT.17.18|Act 17:18.]]† (AS)
(συγχέω), confusion: of a popular uproar, [[r:ACT.19.29|Act 19:29.]]† (AS)

G4748.root: from a derivative of στείχω (to range in regular line)
G4748.strongs: to march in (military) rank (keep step), i.e. (figuratively) to conform to virtue and piety
senses: (στοῖχος, a row), to be in rows (of waves, plants, etc., as well as of men), to walk in line (esp. of marching in file to battle; Xen., Cyr., vi, 3, 34, al.). Metaphorical, in late writers, to walk by rule: [[r:ACT.21.24|Act 21:24]]; with dative, to walk by or in (as a rule of life), [[r:ROM.4.12|Rom 4:12]] (cf. MM, xxiii), [[r:GAL.5.25|Gal 5:25 6:16]], [[r:PHP.3.16|Php 3:16]] (cf. συν-στοιχέω).† (AS)
συν-κατα-βαίνω (Rec. συγκ-), to go down with: [[r:ACT.25.5|Act 25:5.]] In late writers also metaphorically (Wis, l.with), to condescend, on WH. see Rutherford, NPhr., 485 f.† (AS)

narrowness of space, want of room (Thuc., al.). Metaphorical (Ken., Polyb., [[r:DEU.28.53|Deu 28:53]], [[r:WIS.5.3|Wis 5:3]], al.), difficulty, distress: θλίψις καὶ (ἢ) σ., [[r:ROM.2.9|Rom 2:9 8:35]] (EV, anguish); pl. (cf. Bl., § 32, 6; WM, 220), [[r:2CO.6.4|2Co 6:4 12:10]].† SYN.: θλίψις, q.v (AS)

G4789.strongs: a co-heir, i.e. (by analogy) participant in common
senses: συν-κληρο-νόμος (Rec. συγκ-), -ου, ὁ a co-inheritor, fellow-heir: [[r:ROM.8.17|Rom 8:17]], [[r:EPH.3.6|Eph 3:6]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:HEB.11.9|Heb 11:9]], [[r:1PE.3.7|1Pe 3:7]] (for exx., see Deiss., LAE, 88 f.).† (AS)

G4781.strongs: to bend together, i.e. (figuratively) to afflict
senses: συν-κάμπτω (Rec. συγκ-), to bend completely, bend together: τ. νῶτον, figuratively, [[r:ROM.11.10|Rom 11:10]] (LXX).† (AS)

συν-κοινωνός (Rec. συγκ-), όν, partaking jointly of: with genitive of thing(s), [[r:ROM.11.17|Rom 11:17]], [[r:1CO.9.23|1Co 9:23]]; id. with genitive of person(s), [[r:PHP.1.7|Php 1:7]]; before ἐν, [[r:REV.1.9|Rev 1:9.]]† (AS)
Stachys: [[r:ROM.16.9|Rom 16:9]] (see Lft., Phi., 174; MM, xxiii).† (AS)

G4793.strongs: to judge of one thing in connection with another, i.e. combine (spiritual ideas with appropriate expressions) or collate (one person with another by way of contrast or resemblance)
senses: συν-κρίνω (Rec. συγκ-)
to compound, combine: [[r:1CO.2.13|1Co 2:13]], R, mg.1 (Lft., Notes, 180 f.).
In Arist. and later writers ([[r:WIS.7.29|Wis 7:29]], a1.) = παραβάλλω, to compare: 1Co, l.with, R, txt. (Field, Notes, 168), [[r:2CO.10.12|2Co 10:12]]
In LXX, of dreams, to interpret ([[r:GEN.40.8|Gen 40:8]], 1Co, l.with, R, mg. 2 (but see reff. supr.).† (AS)
συν-γνώμη (Rec. συγγ-), -ης, ἡ (συγγιγνώσκω, (a) to agree with; (b) to pardon),
confession.
fellow feeling; hence, concession, allowance: [[r:1CO.7.6|1Co 7:6]] (see ICC, in l).
pardon.† (AS)

G4722.strongs: to roof over, i.e. (figuratively) to cover with silence (endure patiently)
senses: (cf. Lat. tego),
prop., to cover closely, to protect by covering, esp. to keep water in or out (Soph., Plat., al.).
to cover, keep secret, conceal (Sir, l.with, Polyb., al.): [[r:1CO.13.7|1Co 13:7]], R, mg.
By covering to ward of, bear up under, endure (for exx., see, Lft., Notes, 40; M, Th., 36): [[r:1CO.9.12|1Co 9:12 13:7]], [[r:1TH.3.1|1Th 3:1 3:5]].† (AS)

G4786.strongs: to commingle, i.e. (figuratively) to combine or assimilate
senses: συν-κεράννυμι (Rec. συγκ-), to mix or blend together, compound: with accusative, [[r:1CO.12.24|1Co 12:24]]; ptcp. pf. pass., [[r:HEB.4.2|Heb 4:2]], T, WH, mg., R, mg.; id., of persons, with dative instr., to be united with, agree with, ib., WH, txt., R, txt. (see Westc., in l).† (AS)

G4729.strongs: to hem in closely, i.e. (figuratively) cramp
senses: στενο-χωρέω, -ῶ (στενός + χῶρος, space)
to be straitened (cf. [[r:ISA.49.19|Isa 49:19]]); metaphorically, to be anxious (Hipp., al.).
In late writers, trans., to straiten, compress (LXX, Diod., al.; π. ap. MM, xxiii): pass., trop., [[r:2CO.4.8|2Co 4:8 6:12]].† (AS)

G4783.strongs: a deposition (of sentiment) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) accord with
senses: συν-κατά-θεσις (Rec συγκ-), -εως, ἡ (συνκατατίθημι) concord, agreement: [[r:2CO.6.16|2Co 6:16]] (Polyb., Plut., al.).† (AS)

(σπουδή), in haste; hence, zealous, eager, diligent, earnest: before ἐν, [[r:2CO.8.22|2Co 8:22]]; compar., -οτεροσς [[r:2CO.8.17|2Co 8:17]] (here in superl. sense, see Bl., § 44, 3) [[r:2CO.8.22|2Co 8:22.]]† (AS)

G4724.root: probably strengthened from the base of [[w:G2476]]
G4724.strongs: properly, to set fast ("stall"), i.e. (figuratively) to repress (reflexively, abstain from associating with)
senses: στέλλω
prop., to set, place, arrange, fit out; hence, mid., to set oneself for, prepare (Wis, xi Mac, ll. with).

to bring together, gather up (in Hom. of furling sails), hence to restrain, check; mid., to restrain or withdraw oneself, hold aloof, avoid: [[r:2CO.8.20|2Co 8:20]]; before ἀπό, [[r:2TH.3.6|2Th 3:6]] (cf. ἀπο-, ἐξ-απο-, συν-απο-, δια-, ἐπι-, κατα-, συ(ν)-, ὑπο-στέλλω).† (AS)

G4752.forms: στρατεία (on the orthogr., see Deiss., BS, 181 f.), -ας, ἡ
G4752.strongs: military service, i.e. (figuratively) the apostolic career (as one of hardship and danger)
senses: (οτρατεύω), an expedition, a campaign, warfare: metaphorically, [[r:2CO.10.4|2Co 10:4]] (-τιά, T), [[r:1TI.1.18|1Ti 1:18.]]† (AS)

G4769.strongs: properly akin to the base of); a post ("style"), i.e. (figuratively) support
senses: στύλος (T, στῦλος, as in cl.), -ου, ὁ a pillar, regarded especially as a support: σ. πυρός, [[r:REV.10.1|Rev 10:1]]; σ. ἐν τ. ναῷ, figuratively, [[r:REV.3.12|Rev 3:12]], Metaphorical, [[r:GAL.2.9|Gal 2:9]]; τ. ἀληθείας, [[r:1TI.3.15|1Ti 3:15.]]† (AS)

G4704.strongs: to use speed, i.e. to make effort, be prompt or earnest
G4704.kjv: do (give) diligence, be diligent (forward), endeavour, labour, study
senses: (σπουδή), to make haste; hence, to be zealous or eager, to give diligence: with inf. (see M, Pr., 205 f.), [[r:GAL.2.10|Gal 2:10]], [[r:EPH.4.3|Eph 4:3]], [[r:1TH.2.17|1Th 2:17]], [[r:2TI.2.15|2Ti 2:15 4:9 4:21]], [[r:TIT.3.12|Tit 3:12]], [[r:HEB.4.11|Heb 4:11]], [[r:2PE.1.10|2Pe 1:10 3:14]]; with accusative and inf. (on this construction see Mayor in l; MM, xxiii), [[r:2PE.1.15|2Pe 1:15]] (for other constructions see LS, see word).† (AS)

G4747.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of [[w:G4748]]
G4747.strongs: something orderly in arrangement, i.e. (by implication) a serial (basal, fundamental, initial) constituent (literally), proposition (figuratively)
senses: prop., one of a row (στοῖχος) or series, hence,
the shadow-line of a dial (Aristoph.).
an elementary sound or letter of the alphabet (Anth., Plut., π.).
the elements or rudiments of knowledge (Arist., al.) [[r:HEB.5.12|Heb 5:12]]; πτωχὰ σ., [[r:GAL.4.9|Gal 4:9]]; σ. τοῦ κόσμου, [[r:GAL.4.3|Gal 4:3]], [[r:COL.2.8|Col 2:8, 20]] (but see infr.).
The material elements of the universe (Plat.; LXX, ll. with): [[r:2PE.3.10|2Pe 3:10 3:12]].
The heavenly bodies (Ding. Laert.).
The demons or tutelary spirits of nature (Enoch., Test., Sol., al.; for this sense in Ga, Col, ll. with, see ICC on [[r:COL.2.8|Col 2:8]]; Enc. Bibl., see word " Elements ").† (AS)

G4742.root: from a primary στίζω (to "stick", i.e. prick)
G4742.strongs: a mark incised or punched (for recognition of ownership), i.e. (figuratively) scar of service
senses: στίγμα -τος, τό (στίζω, to prick), a tattoed mark or brand: τὰ σ. τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, [[r:GAL.6.17|Gal 6:17]] (see Lft., in l; Deiss., BS, 349; LAE, 303; MM, xxiii).† (AS)

G4790.strongs: to share in company with, i.e. co-participate in
G4790.kjv: communicate (have fellowship) with, be partaker of
senses: συν-κοινωνέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, to have fellowship with or in (in cl., with genitive of thing(s), dative of person(s)): with dative of thing(s), [[r:EPH.5.11|Eph 5:11]], [[r:REV.18.4|Rev 18:4]]; id. with genitive of person(s), [[r:PHP.4.14|Php 4:14.]]† (AS)

G4708.strongs: more speedily, i.e. sooner than otherwise
senses: earnestly, zealously, with vigor; (compar.) all the more eager, with special urgency eagerly earnestly, eagerly, diligently, [[r:LUK.7.4|Lk 7:4]]; [[r:2TI.1.17|2Tim 1:17]]; [[r:TIT.3.13|Tit 3:13]]; comparative σπουδαιοτέρως, more earnestly, with special urgency, [[r:PHP.2.28|Phil. 2:28]]
(στερεόω), a solid body;
a support, foundation (Arist., al.); metaphorically, strength ([[r:PSA.17.1|Psa 17:1-15 70:1-5]], 1Mac, ll. with); steadfastness, firmness: τ. πίστεως, [[r:COL.2.5|Col 2:5]];
the dome of heaven (believed to be a solid canopy), the firmament (LXX).† (AS)
(στόμα), prop., a mouth, an opening;
in early Gk. writers, the throat;
of the opening of the stomach (Arist.); (with) in later writers (Plut., al.), the stomach: [[r:1TI.5.23|1Ti 5:23.]]† (AS)

G4777.strongs: to suffer hardship in company with
senses: συν-κακοπαθέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, to bear evil treatment along with, take one's share of ill-treatment: [[r:2TI.2.3|2Ti 2:3]]; with dative commod., τ. εὐαγγελίῳ, [[r:2TI.2.18|2Ti 2:18.]]† (AS)

G4758.root: from a compound of the base of [[w:G4756]] and [[w:G3004]] (in its original sense)
G4758.strongs: to gather (or select) as a warrior, i.e. enlist in the army
senses: (στρατός, λέγω), to levy a troop, enlist soldiers: [[r:2TI.2.4|2Ti 2:4]] (Diod., Plut., al.).† (AS)

G4737.strongs: to adorn with an honorary wreath (literally or figuratively)
senses: (στέφανος), with accusative of person(s), to crown: of a victor, [[r:2TI.2.5|2Ti 2:5.]] Metaphorical, δόξῃ κ. τιμῇ, [[r:HEB.2.7|Heb 2:7]], 9" (LXX).† (AS)

G4731.strongs: stiff, i.e. solid, stable (literally or figuratively)
senses: hard, firm, solid: τροψή, [[r:HEB.5.12|Heb 5:12, 14]]; θεμέλιος, figuratively, [[r:2TI.2.19|2Ti 2:19.]] Metaphorical,
in bad sense, hard, cruel (Hom., al.);
in good sense, steadfast, firm: τ. πίστει, [[r:1PE.5.9|1Pe 5:9.]]† (AS)

G4767.root: from a derivative of an obsolete apparently primary στύγω (to hate)
senses: (στυγέω, to hate), hated, hateful: [[r:TIT.3.3|Tit 3:3.]]† (AS)
στάρνος, -ου (ὁ and), ἡ prop., an earthen jar for racking off wine, hence, generally, a jar: [[r:HEB.9.4|Heb 9:4.]]† (AS)

G4778.strongs: to maltreat in company with, i.e. (passively) endure persecution together
senses: συν-κακουχέομαι (Rec. συγκ-), -οῦμαι, pass. to endure adversity with: with dative of person(s), [[r:HEB.11.25|Heb 11:25.]] Not elsewhere.† (AS)
(σπείρω),
a sowing.
seedtime.
seed sown (of human offspring, Soph., Tr., 316, 420): [[r:1PE.1.23|1Pe 1:23]] (cf. σπέρμα, and see Milligan, NTD, 105 f.).† (AS)

G4761.strongs: to wrench, i.e. (specially), to torture (by the rack), but only figuratively, to pervert
senses: (στρέφω), to twist, torture. Metaphorical (cf. 2Ki, l.with), to twist or pervert language: [[r:2PE.3.16|2Pe 3:16.]]† (AS)
(στηρίζω),
a setting firmly, supporting.
fixedness, firmness, steadfastness: [[r:2PE.3.17|2Pe 3:17.]]† (AS)
(cf. Lat. strenuus), insolent luxury, wantonness: [[r:REV.18.3|Rev 18:3]] (a late word, first found in a Comic poet, B.C. 300, see Kennedy, Sources, 41, cf. στρηνιάω).† (AS)

(στρῆνος, which see), a word which first appears in the middle comedy (Rutherford, NPhr., 475 f.), to run riot, wax wanton: [[r:REV.18.7|Rev 18:7-9]] (cf. κατα-στρηνιάω).† SYN.: σπαταλάω (which see), τρυφάω (AS)
